summary: 30 of 40 pass, 10 fail. No quote is fabricated: every evidence line appears on its page, mostly with the wikilink brackets or markdown stripped, and the two non-quote notes are marked as paraphrase. Nine of the ten failures are cuts, and they share one cause. The reader tested 'does either page name the other' and stopped there. It missed reasons carried in a hub's Context (1 from 2), on the target page (Web Audio Worklet's test plan), in the Symposium voices (Adjacent Affordance→Stoicism), in SUBSTRATE's anatomy face (the pages and links organs), and in mechanisms both pages describe without a wikilink (yellow-health compression, the enchanted moderator, the coordinator of resource requests, pheromone). Two cut rationales also state false facts: Palace Enchantment holds no edge to SUBSTRATE, and Excellent Adventure holds no edge back to Confucianism. The one failed label (Reference→Resonant Link Labels) rests on a sentence that lives on SCHEMA, not on either page. The labels and retypes are sound: nineteen of twenty pass.
